name: Asset
description: Owns managed tangible and intangible asset identity, stewardship, rights and obligation references, custody, assignments, condition and lifecycle; not stock quantities or financial recognition.

provides.description: Register, classify, identify and query managed assets.
Manage time-bounded title claims, custody, management, rights and assignments.
Record condition, inspections, servicing and applicable entitlement observations.
Control commissioning, suspension, transfer, renewal, disposal and corrections.
Maintain scoped evidence associations, provenance and valuation references.
Govern scoped external authority, synchronisation and reconciliation.
Publish confirmed source-owned lifecycle and stewardship changes.

relationships.rationale: Accounting owns carrying amounts, depreciation and financial treatment; Asset supplies operational evidence.
